identificationModule.briefTitle: European Celecoxib Trial in Primary Breast Cancer
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase III Multicentre Double Blind Randomised Trial of Celecoxib Versus Placebo in Primary Breast Cancer Patients

armGroups.label: Celecoxib
armGroups.description: Patients in this arm will receive 400mg of celecoxib once daily. In addition, Hormone Receptor (+) patients will receive endocrine treatment according to local practice.

armGroups.label: Placebo
armGroups.description: Patients in this arm will receive 2 tablets once daily. In addition Hormone Receptor (+) patients will receive endocrine treatment according to local practice.

interventions.name: Celecoxib
interventions.description: Patients will receive 400mg of Celecoxib once daily for two years or until disease progression (if before the two years limit) or until development of unacceptable toxicities. In addition ER(+) patients will receive endocrine treatment according to local practice.

interventions.name: Placebo
interventions.description: Two capsules once daily with food
